# LottoScope — Historical Draw Analysis

LottoScope provides historical draw results, number frequencies, gap metrics, and pair co-occurrence statistics for Vietlott lottery games (`lotto_535`, `mega_645`, `power_655`).
All statistics are purely historical and descriptive; LottoScope does not predict future draws or guarantee outcomes.

## Static AI-Readable Data Pages (Server-Rendered)

- [All Games Overview (HTML)](https://lottoscope-sable.vercel.app/data): Latest draws, top number frequencies, and top co-occurring pairs across Lotto 5/35, Mega 6/45, and Power 6/55.
- [All Games Overview (Markdown)](https://lottoscope-sable.vercel.app/data?format=md): Plain Markdown format for direct LLM consumption.
- [Lotto 5/35 Statistics](https://lottoscope-sable.vercel.app/data/lotto_535): Recent draws, main numbers (01-35) frequency & gaps, special numbers (01-12) frequency & gaps, and top pairs.
- [Mega 6/45 Statistics](https://lottoscope-sable.vercel.app/data/mega_645): Recent draws, number frequencies & gaps (01-45), and top pairs.
- [Power 6/55 Statistics](https://lottoscope-sable.vercel.app/data/power_655): Recent draws, main number frequencies & gaps (01-55), and top pairs.

Query parameters supported on `/data` and `/data/{game}`:
- `window`: `last_draws` (default), `date_range`, or `all_time`.
- `count`: `10`, `20`, `30` (default), `50`, or `100` recent draws (analytics window only).
- `from_date` & `to_date`: `YYYY-MM-DD` range (max 3650 days; filters both `date_range` analytics and raw draws).
- `as_of_draw_id`: optional cutoff draw ID for historical analytics snapshot.
- `draw_limit` & `draw_page` & `draw_sort`: raw draw history pagination (`1..100` rows per page, `desc` or `asc`), independent of `count`.
- `draw_id`: optional exact draw ID lookup in raw draw history.
- `pair_limit` & `pair_page`: co-occurring pair pagination (`1..100` pairs per page).
- `format`: `html` (default), `md` (Markdown), or `csv` (RFC-4180 CSV).
- `section` (when `format=csv`): `draws` (default), `numbers`, `special` (`lotto_535` only), or `pairs`.

## Read-Only JSON API Endpoints

- `GET /api/v1/games`: List supported games and number ranges.
- `GET /api/v1/games/{game}/status`: Latest draw ID, date, and data version.
- `GET /api/v1/games/{game}/draws/latest`: Latest draw result.
- `GET /api/v1/games/{game}/draws?page=1&page_size=30&sort=desc`: Paginated draw history.
- `GET /api/v1/games/{game}/analytics/numbers?window=last_draws&count=30&sort=frequency_desc`: Number frequencies, ranks, and gap metrics (`number_kind=main|special` for `lotto_535`).
- `GET /api/v1/games/{game}/analytics/pairs?window=last_draws&count=30&page=1&page_size=25&sort=frequency_desc`: Co-occurring main-number pairs.

## WebMCP Client-Side Tools

When opened in a WebMCP-enabled browser (`document.modelContext`), the application registers read-only tools (`get_games`, `get_game_status`, `get_latest_draw`, `get_draws`, `get_number_frequencies`, `get_number_detail`, `get_pair_frequencies`, `check_combination`).
